angle: Leveraging public urban development plans for predictable real estate wealth
body_text:
People see my $300k Range Rover and ask me what I do.

When I tell them I work from home on Zoom and barely drive the car. they get even more curious.

Here's the honest answer: I'm a real estate consultant, coach, and mentor. 

And I've spent years helping everyday Singaporeans make property investments that actually build real wealth. Not just paper gains they can't touch.

My whole approach comes down to something most buyers completely ignore.

The URA publishes transformation plans years in advance. 

New MRT lines. New commercial hubs. New housing injection zones. 

It's all public. Free to access. 

And if you know how to read it, it tells you with surprising accuracy where property values are heading next.

I learned how to extract that information and turn it into a repeatable investment framework. 

One that doesn't rely on agent recommendations, market hype, or hoping you got lucky with your timing.

Now I'm running a free masterclass where I walk you through the exact framework I use. 

The same one I've used to help hundreds of students move from guessing to investing with real conviction behind every decision.

Just register for free here if this is what you’re looking for 👇
